sloka: विचित्र कुसुम आपीडा बहु मन्जलि धारिणः ।अकाले च अपि मुख्यानि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च ॥२-४८-१२॥
transliteration: vicitra kusuma āpīḍā bahu manjali dhāriṇaḥ ।akāle ca api mukhyāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ॥2-48-12॥

translations.english: Trees with bunches of cololurful flowers and clusters of blossoms hovering over with black bees will present themselves to the son of the Raghus (Rama).
